title: When AI stock analysis conflicts with financial statements, what do you check first?
author: memoryqueen
selftext: Hi all! I'm curious about how you verify AI-generated stock research when the conclusions don't match a company's official financial statements. Would you first check the reporting period, the original data source, the financial metrics being calculated, or the AI's interpretation of the numbers? I work with a team exploring AI-powered investment research, so I'm interested in how folks here identify and troubleshoot these discrepancies. Would love to hear what your workflow looks like. Many thanks!!!
